backend_decision.reason: GPU failed fixed numerical tolerances in both arms; CPU passed both arms. No tolerance, source, config, budget, seeds, or initialization changed.
backend_decision.environment: existing sdbca, Python 3.10.20, core runtime pins match
backend_decision.hardware_caveat: Titan CPU versus Zeus CPU remains a host/platform difference; backend is CPU on both, and the fixed fixture passed tolerance, not a guarantee of bitwise trajectories.

scope_note: Only the eight released replica 02-05 full/BCA and zero/TD3+BC jobs were executed on Titan. Remaining Zeus jobs require separately authorized result collection and aggregation.
scientific_caveats: CPU/GPU fixture comparison failed the fixed gate, so GPU was not used for experimental training. Titan CPU passed the fixed tolerance comparison against Zeus CPU; host, OS, Python patch and ancillary package differences remain.
Global calibration uses 128 pooled rows. Rare critical counts across replicas remain 1,3,0,0,1; zero retention has no critical calibration support. No critical-region certification follows.
No paired method effect can be inferred from this eight-job subset; matched arms are in Zeus-owned partitions.
Terminal 100000-update results are primary; 50000-update validation is descriptive. No outcome-based tuning or checkpoint selection.
